tokens.name: --opacity-ambient-light
tokens.role: Peak strength of the cover light behind a page header on the light theme. The contrast proof is apps/web/src/scripts/ambientPalette.test.ts.

tokens.name: --opacity-ambient-dark
tokens.role: The same on the dark theme, where a tint needs more to read.

tokens.name: --color-surface
tokens.role: Page background. Safari 26 samples this for the status bar tint. A cool off-white in light mode: pure white behind a full page of text glares; sheets and floating chrome stay white and read as raised.

tokens.name: --color-surface-sunken
tokens.role: Wells, inputs, hover fills, track backgrounds.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container
tokens.role: The tonal fill of a control that sits on the page: the search pill, a play chip, a secondary button, an unselected filter chip. Reads against the page without an outline.

tokens.name: --color-surface-raised
tokens.role: Sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: --color-surface-overlay
tokens.role: Floating chrome: mini player, popovers.

tokens.name: --color-surface-inverse
tokens.role: Toasts.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface-reading
tokens.role: Running text read under a heading in on-surface: a story's summary, an episode highlight. One step under the heading's ink so the headline leads with no change of size or weight (no heading is bold, D125); 7:1 on the page and 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface-muted
tokens.role: Secondary text. 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface-subtle
tokens.role: Tertiary text. Still 4.5:1 on every surface; never lighter.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface-disabled
tokens.role: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG 1.4.3.

tokens.name: --color-border-hairline
tokens.role: Decorative dividers. Below 3:1 by intent; never the only identifier of a control.

tokens.name: --color-border-control
tokens.role: Boundary of an input or segmented control. 3:1 against its surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: --color-track
tokens.role: Rail and scrubber track.

tokens.name: --color-track-strong
tokens.role: Unplayed item ticks and upcoming nodes.

tokens.name: --color-accent
tokens.role: Lingonberry. Interactive emphasis, progress, current state. Used as text at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --color-accent-subtle
tokens.role: Tint behind the current row. Text on it stays on-surface or accent.

tokens.name: --color-accent-container
tokens.role: The selected state of a control: a chosen chip or segment, the current destination, a tonal button, the playing chip. Text on it is on-accent-container.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent-container
tokens.role: Text and icons on accent-container.

tokens.name: --color-accent-container-high
tokens.role: The tone of an action that is not a place: the New episode buttons. Stronger than accent-container, so it is not read as the current destination or a chosen chip beside it. Text on it is on-accent-container-high.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent-container-high
tokens.role: Text and icons on accent-container-high.

tokens.name: --color-accent-action
tokens.role: The tone of the one creating action in the side column (Catch up). Richer than accent-container, so it reads as an action and never as the current place. A saturated blue in both themes, as the greyed blues before it looked muddy in light and desaturated in dark (owner, 2026-10-27): in light blue-500 with white words, a step brighter than the full accent (blue-600); in dark blue-400 with the darkest blue's words. It reaches 3:1 against the page as a shape, with no outline or shadow. Text on it is on-accent-action.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent-action
tokens.role: Text and icons on accent-action, at 4.5:1 in rest, hover and press.

tokens.name: --color-accent-action-state
tokens.role: The ink accent-action's hover and press layers mix in. It moves the fill away from the words, so they gain contrast in every state: in light the words are white and the fill deepens toward the darkest blue; in dark the words are the darkest blue and the fill lightens toward blue-50, a white that keeps the blue's hue (pure white has none, and the oklch mix drifted toward violet).

tokens.name: --color-cover-accent
tokens.role: Defaults to the accent. The expanded player overrides it per digest from the cover palette (see design spec, color flow).

tokens.name: --color-focus-gap
tokens.role: Inner ring color. Components on raised surfaces override it locally.

tokens.name: --color-image-outline
tokens.role: 1px outline on covers for perceived edge, per DESIGN.md.

tokens.name: --layout-gutter-wide

tokens.name: --layout-player-dialog

tokens.name: --layout-mini-max
tokens.role: Mini player max width.

tokens.name: --layout-window-controls
tokens.role: Reserved top-leading corner for iPadOS windowed apps. env() does not report it.

tokens.name: --layout-measure
tokens.role: Reading measure cap. In rem, not ch: 68ch resolved to about 702px in this face, wider than the 592px reading column, so it capped nothing and summary lines ran to 85 characters.

tokens.name: --icon-bold
tokens.role: 0 draws the regular weight, 1 the bold weight (Phosphor's own bold, not a stroke on the regular). Every Icon holds both; this picks one. A style that wants heavier line icons sets it to 1 (D268).

tokens.name: --size-touch
tokens.role: Minimum touch target. WCAG 2.5.5 and Apple HIG.

tokens.name: --size-option
tokens.role: A row in a list that opens as a bottom sheet on a phone: a select's, a picker's, a menu's. One height, so they read as one sheet.

tokens.name: --size-icon-sm
tokens.role: A glyph inside a line of text: a source link's arrow, an error's mark, a chevron after a label.

tokens.name: --breakpoint-side
tokens.role: The side navigation replaces the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: --breakpoint-aside
tokens.role: The story list column appears beside the briefing.

tokens.name: --cover-size-hero
tokens.role: The cover in a page header on a phone, over the title. Never smaller than the wide header's, so the cover does not shrink when its Library card opens into its page.

tokens.name: --cover-size-hero-wide
tokens.role: The cover in a page header from 40rem: as tall as the title, its facts and Play stacked beside it.

tokens.name: --rail-gutter
tokens.role: Space reserved left of the briefing for the rail.

tokens.name: --rail-center
tokens.role: Distance from the briefing's leading edge to the rail line center.

tokens.name: --rail-node
tokens.role: Item node diameter.

tokens.name: --rail-node-chapter
tokens.role: Chapter node edge. A rounded square, so chapters and items read as different marks at a glance.

tokens.name: --rail-node-halo
tokens.role: Halo spread around the current node.

tokens.name: --item-gap
tokens.role: Between two stories, split by the hairline: half above it, half below.

tokens.name: --cta-radius-pressed
tokens.role: The corners of a filled call to action held down: the pill by default; a style may squeeze it into a softer rectangle.

tokens.name: --action-tonal-radius
tokens.role: A 16px rounded rectangle, the one recorded exception to the pill rule (D186): the side column's Catch up, so its shape alone tells it from the pill-shaped current row beside it (owner, 2026-10-27).

tokens.name: --button-radius
tokens.role: A full pill, as every Google button is. Rows and fields have their own radius (row.radius, field.radius).

tokens.name: --mini-player-inset
tokens.role: Padding inside the bar and gap to the viewport edge.

tokens.name: --mini-player-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: control radius (sm) plus inset padding.

tokens.name: --player-bg
tokens.role: Neutral. The player no longer takes a tint from the cover.

tokens.name: --player-dismiss-distance
tokens.role: Fraction of sheet height past which a slow release dismisses.

tokens.name: --player-dismiss-velocity
tokens.role: Release velocity in px per ms past which any downward flick dismisses.

tokens.name: --scrubber-track-active
tokens.role: Rendered as scaleY(2) of the track while dragging.

tokens.name: --scrubber-chapter-gap
tokens.role: The gap cut into the timeline where a story starts, as YouTube cuts chapters.

tokens.name: --scrubber-tick-dot
tokens.role: A marker on the timeline where a story starts: one small dot, the same for every story.

tokens.name: --scrubber-detent-hysteresis
tokens.role: Fraction of an item's length a scrub must move back before the same detent re-arms.

tokens.name: --segmented-height
tokens.role: As tall as a select or a field beside it.

tokens.name: --segmented-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: segment radius (sm) plus track padding.

tokens.name: --field-radius
tokens.role: A full pill, as every button, chip and select is (owner, 2026-10-24): one control, one shape.

tokens.name: --field-radius-multiline
tokens.role: A multi-line field cannot be a pill, so it takes half the field's height: its corners draw the same arc as a one-line field's.

tokens.name: --field-max-height-multiline
tokens.role: A multi-line field grows with its text up to this, then scrolls inside, so what sits under it (a count, a Reset) stays in reach (the Structure prompt, 2026-10-24).

tokens.name: --field-label-gap
tokens.role: A label onto the field it names: 12px, a step over 8 so the label does not sit on the outline, and under the gap between two fields (24px) so it still belongs to its own (owner, 2026-10-29).

tokens.name: --field-chevron-gap
tokens.role: Value text to chevron, on every dropdown.

tokens.name: --switch-radius
tokens.role: A capsule: track and thumb are both fully round, so they stay concentric at any size.

tokens.name: --sheet-row-radius
tokens.role: Rows inside a sheet panel.

tokens.name: --toast-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: action radius (sm) plus padding.

tokens.name: --archive-row-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: cover thumb radius (sm) plus row padding.

tokens.name: --chip-height
tokens.role: Visible height. The hit area extends to the touch size.

tokens.name: --chip-padding-start
tokens.role: Tighter on the glyph side, so the mark sits optically inside the pill.

tokens.name: --chip-glyph
tokens.role: The slot the play, pause, check, bars and spinner share.

tokens.name: --chip-ring
tokens.role: The stroke of one bar of the playing mark, and the gap between bars.

tokens.name: --chip-icon
tokens.role: The play or pause mark in its slot.

tokens.name: --chip-radius-selected
tokens.role: A ticked filter chip's corners. Equal to the chip's own radius by default; a style may make a selection change shape.

tokens.name: --app-bar-height
tokens.role: Top bar, before the top safe area is added.

tokens.name: --nav-bar-height
tokens.role: Bottom navigation on phones, before the bottom safe area is added.

tokens.role: The pill behind the current destination's icon in the bottom bar.

tokens.role: The current destination's pill in the bottom bar and the side rail: fully round by default; a style may make it a rounded rectangle.

tokens.name: --nav-side-width
tokens.role: Side navigation from 64rem: the wordmark over three destinations.

tokens.name: --nav-side-item-height
tokens.role: One destination row in the side navigation.

tokens.name: --nav-side-item-bg
tokens.role: Fill behind the current destination: the pill in the bottom bar and the row in the side column.

tokens.name: --nav-side-item-fg
tokens.role: Label and icon of the current destination.

tokens.name: --row-padding-block
tokens.role: Space above and below an archive or settings row. Stories use item.gap.

tokens.name: --row-radius
tokens.role: A tappable row, a list option and the state layer over them.

tokens.name: --row-tile-radius
tokens.role: A link row's tile on the page (.row-action, the Sources list): fully round, as the rail's rows and a card's tiles are (owner, 2026-10-24: "full curved borders so it is consistent with the rest of the design language"). In a card the tile takes the card's inner radius instead.

tokens.name: --slider-max-width
tokens.role: The widest a slider grows in a row, so the name beside it keeps the room (owner, 2026-10-25).

tokens.name: --picker-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: the inner radius plus the inset. The list's own outer radius.

tokens.name: --picker-inset
tokens.role: From the list's edge to the search field and to the options. The card's inset, 4px.

tokens.name: --picker-inner-radius
tokens.role: The search field and each option, one inset in. 24px: a full pill on the 48px search field, the same on every row.

tokens.name: --card-padding
tokens.role: From the card's edge to its rows' words, and to its chips. The page's title, heads and notes start the same distance in, so a page with cards has one left text edge (2026-10-22).

tokens.name: --card-inset
tokens.role: From the card's edge to a surface inside it, on every side: a row's hover tile, a select's fill. Two tiles sit the same distance apart. 4px, so a tile and its target are nearly the card's width (owner, 2026-10-24: "4px padding is decent").

tokens.name: --card-radius
tokens.role: Concentric: a surface's inner radius plus its inset.

tokens.name: --card-inner-radius
tokens.role: A row's hover tile, one inset in from the card's edge: the card's radius less the inset.

tokens.name: --card-content-radius
tokens.role: Content one padding in from the card's edge (a chip, a button, a field, a picture): the card's radius less its padding.

tokens.name: --card-chip-hover
tokens.role: The hover layer of a chip on a card: half the state layer in light, where the chip is white and the full 8% would take it past the card's own tone (L 94 on L 95) so it melted in; the full layer in dark, where hover lifts the chip away from the card (owner, 2026-10-24).
